feeds.title: World Trade Organization News
feeds.description: The World Trade Organization (WTO) deals with the global rules of trade between nations. Its main function is to ensure that global trade flows smoothly, predictably, and freely as possible.

feeds.title: ShippingSolutions.com Blog

The blog is written by import-export professionals with in-depth knowledge and experience in these areas and the topics cover Automated Export Systems, Dangerous Goods/Hazmat, Export Basics, Export Compliance, Export Finance, and many more.

Armed with Baker McKenzie's insight and foresight, business leaders can feel confident in driving growth that is both sustainable - and inclusive.

feeds.title: Global Trade Magazine

feeds.title: Customs & International Trade Law Expert | News & Articles

feeds.title: International Economic Law and Policy Blog
feeds.description: This blog offers commentary on current developments and scholarship in the field of international economic law and policy. One of our goals with this blog is to stimulate discussion of trade issues.

feeds.title: International Trade and Customs Blog
feeds.description: The Customs and International Trade Department, located in Paris and Brussels, provides a wide range of advisory and national and EU litigation services to its clients, in the field of customs law, indirect taxation and international trade regulations. Our team has a great knowledge of customs proceedings, of the various customs authorities (DGDDI, European Commission, WCO, WTO), and of the competent national, EU and international judicial authorities.

feeds.title: Tradeology, The Official ITA Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the International Trade Administration is to create prosperity by strengthening the competitiveness of U.S. industry, promoting trade and investment, and ensuring fair trade and compliance with trade laws and agreements. Through its websites and other online resources, the International Trade Administration offers broad public access to a wide range of information.

feeds.title: Barnes Trade Law Blog

Our work includes matters originating both in and outside the United States, and our clients include companies ranging from sole proprietorships to major multinationals. In fact, we've advised over one-third of the manufacturers among the Fortune 100 in trade and customs matters.
